name: ADMA Biologics
summary:
ADMA Biologics (ADMA) reported earnings of $0.19 per share on revenue of $114.49 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus revenue estimate was revenue of $611.67 million. Revenue fell 0.27% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects 2026 revenue of $530.0 million to $560.0 million. The company's previous guidance was for revenue to exceed $635.0 million, but the current consensus revenue estimate is $611.67 million for the year ending December 31, 2026.

ADMA Biologics Inc along with its wholly owned subsidiary is a late stage biopharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets specialty plasma-based biologics for the treatment and prevention of certain infectious diseases.
